lines.en: label christmasfive2:
scene clearnightsky
But for now, I must return home to the girl I {i}started{/i} the day with. And anyone else who may have found their way inside during my absence.
lines.zh: 但眼下,我必须先回到那个陪我{i}开始{/i}这一天的女孩身边。以及任何在我外出期间设法混进屋子里的人。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet1
So, the Tsukiokas apparently.
lines.zh: 看来是 Tsukioka 家的人。

lines.en: : Hey, guys. Check out this cool knife I just got.
lines.zh: : 嘿,各位。看看我刚弄到的这把刀,酷不酷。

lines.en: : That is very nice, Sensei. Thank you for showing us.
lines.zh: : 非常不错,Sensei。谢谢你给我们看。

lines.en: Now, you may be asking “what are these two doing here so late? And on Chrismas Eve nonetheless?”
lines.zh: 现在你可能会问:「这两个人这么晚在这儿干什么?而且还是在平安夜?」

lines.en: Me too.
lines.zh: 我也想知道。

lines.en: But I imagine it has something to do with the Christmas party based on the way Tsubasa is happily clasping her hands together and staring at me like the piece of meat I am.
lines.zh: 不过看 Tsubasa 双手合十、一脸开心地盯着我的样子——就像盯着一块肉——我猜这跟圣诞派对有关。

lines.en: Oh, right. I probably should have mentioned the party is going to be at their place this year.
lines.zh: 哦,对。我大概早该提一句,今年的派对会办在她们家。

lines.en: Surprise.
lines.zh: 惊喜吧。

lines.en: : Excellent! Just the man I was hoping to encounter.
lines.zh: : 太好了!正好是我想碰见的那个人。

lines.en: : Sorry, Tsubasa. I’m all tapped out for today. So if you’re looking for a Chrismas date too, you’re going to need to wait until tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Tsubasa。我今天已经排满了。所以如果你也想约圣诞约会,你得等到明天。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet2
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么?

lines.en: : Nothing. Please don’t kill me.
lines.zh: : 没什么。求你别杀我。

lines.en: : {i}Hah.{/i} Sensei, we’re here to discuss the logistics of this year’s Christmas party.
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}。Sensei,我们是来讨论今年圣诞派对的筹备事宜的。

lines.en: : I figured. You should have heard my thoughts just a second ago.
lines.zh: : 我猜到了。你该听听我一秒钟前在想什么。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet3
: Right! So, the situation is like this.
lines.zh: : 对!那么,情况是这样的。

lines.en: : Tsukasa will be spending the evening with you as well. Thank you for your assistance in watching over her.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 今晚也会和你们一起过。谢谢你们帮忙照看她。

lines.en: : What? That’s a terrible idea. The girls are always really insistent on kissing each other during that party and she might get caught up in the crossfire.
lines.zh: : 什么?那主意糟透了。派对上那些女孩总是非得要互相亲吻,她很可能会被卷进交火里。

lines.en: : We can always just...omit her from spin the bottle. Or not play it altogether.
lines.zh: : 我们可以……把她从转瓶子里排除出去。或者干脆不玩那个游戏。

lines.en: : But then I won’t get to {i}see{/i} you all kiss each other and that’s become my favorite part of Christmas.
lines.zh: : 可那样我就{i}看不到{/i}你们互相亲吻了,而那已经成了我圣诞节最喜欢的部分。

lines.en: : You weren’t even there last year. You were in a coma.
lines.zh: : 你去年根本就不在场。你在昏迷。

lines.en: : That doesn’t mean I wasn’t dreaming about it.
lines.zh: : 那也不代表我没有梦到过。

lines.en: : My, what an interesting life you lead! You can tell my youngest daughter all about it while you’re tending to her at the party.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,你过的生活真是有趣!派对上你照顾我小女儿的时候,可以把这些都讲给她听。

lines.en: : Apologies, Sensei. I’ve already tried reasoning with Mother. But, as it turns out, my father will be hosting several of his associates in the grand ballroom during the time of {i}our{/i} party and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Sensei。我已经试着跟母亲讲道理了。但结果是,{i}我们{/i}派对的那段时间,我父亲要在大宴会厅接待他的几位生意伙伴,而且——

lines.en: : And only “Jeeves” can prevent Tsukasa from intervening and potentially ruining any dealings Tomonori and I will be involved in. Thank you again for your assistance.
lines.zh: : 而只有「Jeeves」能阻止 Tsukasa 插进来、可能毁掉我和 Tomonori 要谈的生意。再次谢谢你的帮忙。

lines.en: : Why are you working on Christmas? Take a day off.
lines.zh: : 你为什么圣诞节还要工作?放自己一天假吧。

lines.en: if saraspring2 == True:
: I would love to! But I’ve already used my free time this quarter drinking wine as I watched you donate milk to those less fortunate.
lines.zh: : 我也想啊!可我这季度的空闲时间已经用来喝着葡萄酒、看你给那些不幸的人捐献牛奶了。

lines.en: : What a strange way to word that.
lines.zh: : 这措辞可真奇怪。

lines.en: : I had no idea you’d gotten involved with charity work, Sensei. Perhaps I can help you donate milk as well in the future?
lines.zh: : 我不知道你还做起慈善了,Sensei。也许以后我也能帮你捐献牛奶?

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet4
: Yes! Wouldn’t {i}that{/i} be nice?
lines.zh: : 是啊!{i}那{/i}不是很好吗?

lines.en: : Just {i}please{/i} do me this one {i}little{/i} favor and I’ll see to it that your wildest dreams come true.
lines.zh: : 只要你帮我这一个{i}小小{/i}的忙,我保证让你最疯狂的梦想成真。

lines.en: else:
: Vacation days are for those in lower tax brackets, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是,只有税率更低的人才有资格休年假。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet4
: Just {i}please{/i} do me this one {i}little{/i} favor and I’ll see to it that your wildest dreams come true.
lines.zh: : 只要你帮我这一个{i}小小{/i}的忙,我保证让你最疯狂的梦想成真。

lines.en: : You are gravely underestimating just how wild my dreams are.
lines.zh: : 你严重低估了我的梦想有多疯狂。

lines.en: : And {i}you{/i} are gravely underestimating just how important this meeting is. Just agree, darling. You really don’t have a say in the matter.
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}也严重低估了这场会面有多重要。答应吧,亲爱的。这件事真由不得你。

lines.en: : Forgive Mother’s pushiness tonight, Sensei. This is a rather last-minute arrangement and I believe that one of our staff members may have spiked her eggnog.
lines.zh: : 请原谅母亲今晚的咄咄逼人,Sensei。这安排得相当临时,而且我觉得可能是哪个下人在她的蛋奶酒里掺了东西。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So we can use the fact that she’s drunk to justify her asking me to babysit your sister. That works.
lines.zh: : 哦,好吧。那我们可以用她喝醉了这一点,来解释她为什么让我照顾你妹妹。说得通。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet5
: {i}Drunk?{/i} Heavens, no. If I was drunk, I imagine you’d be strapped down to something right now.
lines.zh: : {i}喝醉{/i}?天哪,没有。要是我喝醉了,我想你这会儿已经被绑在什么上面了。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: She’s drunk. Don’t listen to her.
lines.zh: : 她醉了。别听她的。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet6
: Then perhaps you should take up negotiations in my stead, Touka? Perhaps there’s something you can add that would sweeten the pot for your beloved teacher?
lines.zh: : 那么也许该由你来接手谈判,Touka?也许你能加点什么,好让你亲爱的老师更心动?

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet7
: B-Beloved?! No! B-Besides! There’s no need for negotiation when Sensei was already planning on agreeing! Weren’t you, S- oh. He’s stopped paying attention to us.
lines.zh: : 亲、亲爱的?!不!再、再说了!Sensei 本来就打算答应,根本不需要谈判!对吧,先——哦。他已经不理我们了。

lines.en: : Perhaps it is because his maid is glaring daggers at him for some reason beyond my comprehension?
lines.zh: : 也许是因为他的女仆正用着我无法理解的理由狠狠瞪着他?

lines.en: : That’s no {i}maid,{/i} Mother. That’s a famous pop star.
lines.zh: : 那不是{i}女仆{/i},母亲。那是一位著名流行歌手。

lines.en: : Ha! And I’m the princess of Andorra.
lines.zh: : 哈!那我还是安道尔公主呢。

lines.en: : But...you {i}are.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可……你确实{i}是{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}Honorarily,{/i} Touka. That’s completely different. Now, be a dear and fetch me a red from Akira’s wine cellar.
lines.zh: : 是{i}名誉上{/i}的,Touka。那完全不一样。好了,乖,去 Akira 的酒窖给我拿瓶红酒来。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet8
: Fine. But I must first {i}find{/i} said wine cellar and I’m unsure of where the poor would even {i}fit{/i} such a thing.
lines.zh: : 好吧。可我得先{i}找到{/i}那个所谓的酒窖,而且我不确定穷人家里能把它{i}塞{/i}在什么地方。

lines.en: : Over here, Touka. I’ll show you.
lines.zh: : 这边,Touka。我带你去。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet7
: Oh, wonderful. Thank you, Ayane. I still feel rather uncomfortable when it comes to places like this.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了。谢谢你,Ayane。在像这样的地方,我还是挺不自在的。

lines.en: : Am I in trouble again? Because you’ve been staring at me for a really long time.
lines.zh: : 我又惹麻烦了?因为你已经盯着我盯了很久了。

lines.en: : I’m just wondering if unidentified women showing up is going to be a normal thing now that I live here.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想,既然我住在这儿了,冒出身份不明的女人会不会成为常态。

lines.en: : I don’t think you want to hear the answer to that question. But if you want a {i}solution,{/i} all you really need to do is identify them and your problem will be no-more.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不会想听这个问题的答案。不过如果你想要个{i}解决办法{/i},你真正要做的就是确认她们的身份,你的问题就没了。

lines.en: : Please don’t make me sleep on the couch in my own house.
lines.zh: : 别让我睡在自己家的沙发上,求你了。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet9
: {i}Hah...{/i}I suppose all I can do is get used to it. Did your {i}date{/i} go well, at least?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我想我也只能习惯它了。至少,你的{i}约会{/i}还顺利吗?

lines.en: : I’d show you the knife I got out of it, but I don’t want you to take it away as punishment for me simply existing.
lines.zh: : 我想给你看我从约会里得到的小刀,可我不想你把它没收,当作我「仅仅存在着」的惩罚。

lines.en: : I’m somewhat {i}confused{/i} by the dynamic at play here. Why is there an apparently famous pop star living with you, Akira? And why do the two of you seem so close?
lines.zh: : 我对这里的状况有点{i}困惑{/i}。为什么有个似乎是著名流行歌手的人住在你这儿,Akira?还有你们俩为什么看起来这么亲密?

lines.en: : I don’t know. She just showed up one day and refuses to leave.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。她某天就出现了,然后死活不肯走。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet10
: We’re childhood friends.
lines.zh: : 我们是青梅竹马。

lines.en: : Oh, are you? How interesting. But why do you appear so pained to admit that?
lines.zh: : 哦,是吗?真有意思。可你为什么承认的时候看起来那么痛苦?

lines.en: : Because I {i}am.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为我{i}确实{/i}痛苦。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet11
: I’m confused. I see no wine cellar here.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。我没看到这里有酒窖。

lines.en: : Is there a secret passage I’m unaware of? Is it behind the curtain? Beneath the tree?
lines.zh: : 是不是有什么我不知道的暗道?在窗帘后面?在圣诞树底下?

lines.en: : There is no wine cellar. I just wanted to prevent you from wandering around looking confused for the next half hour.
lines.zh: : 没有什么酒窖。我只是不想让你接下来半小时在屋里转来转去、一脸茫然。

lines.en: : Where does he keep the wine then?
lines.zh: : 那他把酒藏在哪儿?

lines.en: : People from middle class families don’t always have wine on-hand. That’s kind of a rich person thing.
lines.zh: : 中产阶级家庭的人不一定随时备着酒。那算是富人才有的东西。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet12
: Is that so? I had no idea. Thank you for your assistance, Ayane. You’re as invaluable as ever when it comes to teaching me the ways of these people. I can’t help but admire how well you’ve adapted.
lines.zh: : 是这样吗?我完全不知道。谢谢你的指点,Ayane。在教我了解这些人的生活方式这件事上,你一如既往地不可或缺。我真佩服你适应得这么好。

lines.en: : No worries! It’s kind of easy for me, though. I was actually pretty poor before the whole bubble wrap thing happened.
lines.zh: : 别客气!不过这对我来说挺容易的。在气泡纸那件事之前,我其实挺穷的。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet13
: Oh, joy! That statement makes it sound as if I’m about to be blessed by an anecdote about adversity and the role Christmas plays in reminding you to always remain humble!
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了!你这句话听起来,就像我马上要有幸听到一段关于逆境的轶事,以及圣诞节如何提醒你永远保持谦逊!

lines.en: : No. I don’t have anything like that tonight. I just needed somebody to talk to since Ami and Maya are being weird and Sensei is busy with the other adults.
lines.zh: : 不。今晚我没有那种东西。我只是需要找个人说说话,因为 Ami 和 Maya 都怪怪的,而 Sensei 又在忙着应付其他大人。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet14
: Oh. Well, I suppose {i}I{/i} am someone. But I feel as if neglecting my mother in her current state may lead to her saying or doing something self-destructive.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯,我想{i}我{/i}也算某个人。不过我觉得,在她现在的状态下放着她不管,可能会导致她说出或做出一些自毁的事。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet15
: Really? She seems fine to me. I wouldn’t have even known she was drunk if you hadn’t said something.
lines.zh: : 真的吗?我看她挺正常的。你要是不说,我根本看不出她醉了。

lines.en: : Yes, she hides it well in short bursts. But she can be rather...{i}crass{/i} when it comes to certain subjects.
lines.zh: : 是的,短时间之内她藏得很好。不过一碰到某些话题,她就会变得相当……{i}粗鄙{/i}。

lines.en: : Like...what kind of subjects?
lines.zh: : 比如……什么样的话题?

lines.en: : Physical therapy?
lines.zh: : 物理治疗?

lines.en: : I don’t think they’re going to bring that up, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她们不会聊那个,Touka。

lines.en: : I never do either until it’s too late.
lines.zh: : 我也从来不会,直到为时已晚。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet16

: Well, rest assured that the Arakawa house is a safe zone for everyone! And that anything discussed here shall remain within these walls so long as the concerned party has signed the required waivers.
lines.zh: : 嗯,请放心,Arakawa 家是每个人的安全区!而且在这里讨论的任何事都不会传出这些墙外——只要相关方签署了必要的免责声明。

lines.en: : W...Waivers?
lines.zh: : 免、免责声明?

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet17
: Ah! You didn’t sign the waivers?!
lines.zh: : 啊!你没签免责声明?!

lines.en: : I-I didn’t know there {i}were{/i} waivers! I’ve been here in the past and I’ve never had to sign such a thing before!
lines.zh: : 我、我不知道{i}还有{/i}免责声明!我以前来过这儿,从来没被要求签过这种东西!

lines.en: : Oh my God! You’re in grave danger then, Touka! We’ve gotta get your signature quick or your family’s entire legacy could be in jeopardy!
lines.zh: : 我的天!那你可危险了,Touka!我们得赶紧弄到你的签名,不然你家族的全部遗产都可能岌岌可危!

lines.en: : You know, I’m very glad you’ve brought up the topic of physical therapy, Niki. Because I have many opinions to share concerning-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,Niki,你提起物理治疗这个话题我真是太高兴了。因为关于这个,我有很多看法要分享——

lines.en: : Mother, no!
lines.zh: : 母亲,不要!

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet18
: Something I’ve learned tonight is that it’s extremely hard watching movies with a crowd of unruly people who refuse to shut up behind you.
lines.zh: 今晚我学到一件事:跟一群不守规矩、在你身后死活不肯闭嘴的人一起看电影,实在太难了。

lines.en: : And that’s why {i}I{/i} only watch movies at the Alamo Drafthouse.
lines.zh: : 所以{i}我{/i}只在 Alamo Drafthouse 看电影。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet19
scene tsukiokaxmasgreet20
: The what?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Sponsorship message. Don’t worry about it. Besides, the movie’s going to be over soon anyway. And aren’t you going back to the dorms with Ayane to play D&D?
lines.zh: : 赞助广告。别在意。再说了,电影也快结束了。而且你不是要和 Ayane 回宿舍玩龙与地下城吗?

lines.en: : It’s almost midnight already. I just want to sleep at this point. I’m getting too old to be staying up playing games. {i}Especially{/i} when I’m expected to go to a party the next day.
lines.zh: : 已经快午夜了。我现在只想睡觉。我年纪大了,熬不动夜玩游戏了。{i}尤其是{/i}第二天还得去派对。

lines.en: : You could always come with me and Niki to her concert thingy. I’m sure she wouldn’t mind if I brought a friend.
lines.zh: : 你也可以跟我还有 Niki 一起去她的演唱会啊。我相信她不会介意我带个朋友。

lines.en: : Yeah, but then I’d have to actually {i}be around{/i} Niki.
lines.zh: : 是啊,可那样我就得真的跟 Niki {i}待在一起{/i}了。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet21
: She’s not {i}that{/i} bad, Maya! Like sure, she has way too much sex with Sensei. But day by day, I can feel her getting closer to letting me join in!
lines.zh: : 她没{i}那么{/i}糟啦,Maya!当然,她跟 Sensei 上床的次数是多得离谱。可是日子一天天过去,我能感觉到她越来越接近让我加入的那一天了!

lines.en: : Ew.
: Maybe you coming with us to the concert can help get you in on the ground level so we can {i}all{/i} do it together one day?
lines.zh: : 也许你跟我们去演唱会,能从最底层混进来,这样有一天我们就能{i}一起{/i}做了?

lines.en: : Can’t we just do it {i}without{/i} her involved?
lines.zh: : 我们不能就{i}别带上{/i}她吗?

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet22
: We’ll do that too. Especially now that I don’t have to pretend I haven’t made you cum your brains out a million times before.
lines.zh: : 那个我们也会做的。尤其是现在我不用再假装我没让你高潮到脑子都射出来过一百万次了。

lines.en: : Didn’t you agree to stop bringing that up after the whole...{i}reset{/i} thing happened or...whatever you call it?
lines.zh: : 在那一整件……「{i}重置{/i}」的事情发生之后,你不是答应不再提这个了吗?或者……管你们叫什么来着?

lines.en: : I agree to a lot of things. But I’ve learned that I’m the happiest when I just do whatever I want regardless of that. And right now, I’m just surprised you’re still here!
lines.zh: : 我答应过很多事。可我学到了,不管那些、想干什么就干什么的时候我才最开心。而现在,我只是很惊讶你居然还在这儿!

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet23
: But that also makes me really curious about what I {i}can{/i} do to you before you snap. And why you’re still so friendly with me despite the many forced orgasms I’ve made you endure.
lines.zh: : 但这也让我真的很好奇,在你崩溃之前我还{i}能{/i}对你做些什么。还有,为什么在我逼你忍受了那么多次高潮之后,你还对我这么友好。

lines.en: : It’s specifically {i}because{/i} of those things that I feel like I need to stay on good terms with you. I can deal with being chained up every now and then if it brings me closer to figuring out what the fuck is going on here.
lines.zh: : 正{i}因为{/i}这些事,我才觉得有必要跟你保持良好关系。如果能让我更接近弄清楚这里到底他妈的发生了什么,偶尔被锁起来我也能忍。

lines.en: : You sure it’s not just because you want me to finger you again?
lines.zh: : 你确定不只是因为你想让我再用手指弄你?

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多,是啊。

lines.en: : Well, why don’t you just talk to Sensei and Ayane about it then? I’m sure they have {i}some{/i} answers to whatever questions you might have.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不直接跟 Sensei 和 Ayane 谈呢?我相信不管你有什么问题,他们{i}多少{/i}都有答案。

lines.en: : Probably because you told me the moment you realized I was still here that you would blow up the world if I informed them of your existence.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你一发现我还在这儿,就告诉我:要是我向他们透露你的存在,你就炸掉这个世界。

lines.en: : And you {i}believed{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 而你就{i}信{/i}了?

lines.en: : I’d be foolish not to at this point.
lines.zh: : 到了现在,我要是不信才是傻子。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet24
: Awesome! Having a cat rules!
lines.zh: : 太棒了!养只猫就是爽!

lines.en: : If I, like...talked to them about {i}me,{/i} though-
lines.zh: : 不过如果,那个……我跟他们谈了关于{i}我{/i}的事——

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet25
: Oh. Yeah. That’s fine. Just keep me out of it. All things considered, I’m kind of enjoying this timeline. It’s...what’s the word...nostalgic?
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯。那没问题。只要别把我扯进去就行。综合来看,我还挺享受这条时间线的。就是……怎么说来着……怀旧?

lines.en: : Really? You won’t, like...tie me up again if I go “poking my nose in places it doesn’t belong” or whatever?
lines.zh: : 真的?如果我去「把鼻子伸进不该伸的地方」什么的,你不会……再把我绑起来?

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet26
: Not unless you {i}want{/i} me to!
lines.zh: : 除非你{i}想{/i}让我绑!

lines.en: : Or if I get bored. Or angry. Or any other emotion that’s too intense for me to properly process and I need an outlet to vent my frustration.
lines.zh: : 或者我无聊了。或者生气了。或者任何其他强烈到我无法妥善处理、需要找个出口发泄的情绪。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet27
: {i}What?{/i} It’s super creepy when you just look at me like that. Stop.
lines.zh: : {i}怎么{/i}?你那样盯着我看真的很瘆人。别看了。

lines.en: : You’re just...
lines.zh: : 你只是……

lines.en: : So different from the Ami {i}I{/i} remember. It’s kind of surreal.
lines.zh: : 和{i}我{/i}记忆中的那个 Ami 太不一样了。有点超现实。

lines.en: : Like...it still feels like I’m stuck in that dream.
lines.zh: : 就像……我还是觉得自己困在那个梦里。

lines.en: scene black
: That wasn’t a dream, Maya.
lines.zh: : 那不是梦,Maya。

lines.en: : It was something much...{i}much{/i} scarier...
lines.zh: : 那是某种……可怕{i}得多{/i}的东西……

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet28
I manage to escape from Niki and Tsubasa long enough to catch my breath.
lines.zh: 我总算从 Niki 和 Tsubasa 手里脱身,喘了口气。

lines.en: And with the clock creeping ever closer to Christmas, I think it might finally be time for me to close my eyes and wait for what tomorrow brings.
lines.zh: 随着时间一点点逼近圣诞节,我想,我终于该闭上眼睛,等着明天会带来什么了。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet29
It’s great that nothing horrible happened today. I don’t get days like that very often anymore.
lines.zh: 今天什么可怕的事都没发生,真是太好了。这样的日子我已经不常有了。

lines.en: And any opportunity I get to steer clear of past traumas is fine by me.
lines.zh: 而任何能让我避开过去创伤的机会,我都乐于接受。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet30
I’ve gotta take what I can get in Kumon-mi. And right now, that means taking a break.
lines.zh: 在 Kumon-mi,我只能有什么拿什么。而此刻,这意味着休息一下。

lines.en: That’s right. Today is going to be one of those rare nights when-
lines.zh: 没错。今天会是那种罕见的夜晚之一——

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene tsukiokaxmasgreet31
I should have just gone to my room.
lines.zh: 我刚才就该直接回房间的。

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Merry...Christmas?
lines.zh: : 圣诞……快乐?

lines.en: : You sound unsure.
lines.zh: : 你听起来不太确定。

lines.en: : I am...unsure about {i}many{/i} things all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我突然……对{i}很多{/i}事情都不确定了。

lines.en: : Is one of them the amount of time I am willing to speak to you before walking away?
lines.zh: : 其中包括我愿意在转身走开之前跟你聊多久吗?

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, it is.
lines.zh: : 事实上,是的。

lines.en: : Well, time is running out. So if you’ve got anything important to say-
lines.zh: : 那么,时间不多了。如果你有什么重要的话要说——

lines.en: : Retract your breakup with me. Teach me about my other self. Stop ignoring my calls. My birthday is next week. And also, I’m horny.
lines.zh: : 撤回你跟我分手的话。告诉我关于我另一个自己的事。别再不接我电话。下周就是我生日。还有,我发情了。

lines.en: : Like, {i}really{/i} horny. And we both know how you feel about these pajamas. So I think it would be in both of our best interests if you were to rail the fuck out of me right now.
lines.zh: : 就是,{i}非常{/i}想要。而且我们都清楚你对这套睡衣是什么感觉。所以我觉得,为了我们双方的利益,你现在就该他妈的狠狠干我一场。

lines.en: : Like, really just go to town. Pull my hair. Spank me. Choke me. The whole nine yards, buddy.
lines.zh: : 就是,彻底放开手干。扯我头发。打我屁股。掐我脖子。全套都来,老兄。

lines.en: : Did you just call me “Buddy?”
lines.zh: : 你刚才叫我「老兄」?

lines.en: : I am beyond the point of acting rationally right now. This is but one more reason you should whisk me off my feet and carry me away to Bonetown.
lines.zh: : 我现在已经完全没法理性行事了。这也算是你应该把我一把抱起、带我去 Bonetown 的另一个理由。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet32
: Oh, come on! How did that not work?!
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托!这怎么可能不管用?!

lines.en: : Goodnight, Maya.
lines.zh: : 晚安,Maya。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet33
: And merry Christmas.
lines.zh: : 还有,圣诞快乐。

lines.en: : “Merry Christmas” my ass.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐个屁。

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet34
: You just walk away every time I try to talk to you now...
lines.zh: : 现在每次我想跟你说话,你转身就走……

lines.en: : I thought we were finally going somewhere?...
lines.zh: : 我还以为我们终于有进展了?……

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet35
: But then that stupid childhood friend of yours had to show up again and...
lines.zh: : 可那个你那该死的青梅竹马又出现了,而且……

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet36
: I have to persist! That’s what the “old” me did, so that’s what the “new” one will do as well!
lines.zh: : 我必须坚持!以前的「我」就是这么做的,那么「新」的我也会这么做!

lines.en: : He will be mine...
lines.zh: : 他会是我的……

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet37
: Oh, yes.
lines.zh: : 哦,是的。

lines.en: : He {i}will{/i} be mine.
lines.zh: : 他{i}会{/i}是我的。

lines.en: : Hey. Uhh...Maya, right? You okay? Because it seems like you’re talking to yourself and-
lines.zh: : 嘿。呃……Maya,对吧?你还好吗?因为看起来你在跟自己说话,而且——

lines.en: scene tsukiokaxmasgreet38
: Leave me alone! And stop being so perfect! I swear, it’s like you Nakayamas are the luxury cars of Japanese women and I won’t stand for it much longer!
lines.zh: : 别管我!还有别再这么完美了!我发誓,你们 Nakayama 家的人就像日本女人里的豪车,我再也忍不了多久了!

lines.en: : Goodnight! I hope you have a terrible Christmas!
lines.zh: : 晚安!祝你过一个糟糕的圣诞节!

lines.en: scene black
: So is just...{i}everyone{/i} insane here? Or...
lines.zh: : 所以是……这儿{i}所有人{/i}都是疯子吗?还是……
